name: Brain and Cognitive Sciences
notes: 12 required courses; independent study courses (BCSC 391, BCSC 395) do not fulfill any major requirement.

The department page lists STAT 212 (its alternatives STAT 211/213/214, DSCC 262, PSYC/CSSP 211, ECON 230 are case-by-case); STAT 212/213 were renamed STAT 180/190 per the Statistics program, so both code families are accepted here.
A formal methods (statistics) course must be completed before taking a lab course - not auto-enforced.
BCSC 206/207 research sequence: both courses required; 207 fulfills the lab requirement, 206 may count as an upper-level elective.
Electives should form a coherent track (3 of 4 on-theme, at most one 100-level) - adviser-approved, not auto-enforced.

requirementGroups.label: BCS foundation and core
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students must take all of the following courses: BCSC 110 ...; BCSC 111 ...; BCSC 151: Perception and Action; BCSC 152: Language and Psycholinguistics; BCSC 153: Cognition; BCSC 310: Senior Seminar

requirementGroups.label: Formal methods (statistics)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students must take STAT 212: Applied Statistics for Biological and Physical Sciences. ... Alternative statistics courses, such as STAT 211, STAT 213, STAT/BIOL 214, DSCC 262, PSYC/CSSP 211, and ECON 230, will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
requirementGroups.note: Alternatives require department approval; AP statistics credit does not satisfy this.

requirementGroups.label: Laboratory course
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Choose one of the following: BCSC 204: Laboratory in Cognitive Neuroscience; BCSC 205: Laboratory in Development and Learning; BCSC 206/BCSC 207: Undergraduate Research in Cognitive Science; BCSC 208: Laboratory in Perception and Cognition

requirementGroups.label: BCS upper-level electives (4, forming a track)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students are required to take four BCS electives. These electives should be chosen in order to form a coherent theme, or track. ... No more than one 100-level course may be used in the track.

upperLevelWriting.label: Lab course + senior seminar
upperLevelWriting.sourceQuote: Successful completion of the laboratory course and the senior seminar will satisfy the upper-level writing requirement.
